source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 25 (PDF 228-246), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Ecology) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define ecology. How do organisms fulfil their requirements for life?
(Ecology ki tareef karein. Jandar zindagi ki zaroriyaat kaise poori karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ecology (mahooliyat) jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur mahol ke saath talluqaat ka mutalia hai. Jandar doosre jandaron aur tabai mahol ke saath amal kar ke apni zaroriyaat poori karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Ecology is the study of the relationships of organisms with other organisms and the environment

blocks.prompt:
2 Define species with an example from Pakistan.
(Species ki tareef Pakistan ki misaal ke saath karein.)
blocks.explanation: Species jandaron ka aisa group hai jin ki jismani aur genetic khususiyaat milti hon aur sab se ahem yeh ke aapas mein mil kar fertile aulad paida kar sakein. Misaal: Indus River Dolphin; yeh aapas mein nasl barhati hain, doosri dolphins ke saath fertile bachay nahi.

book_ref.quote: a group of organisms that share similar physical and genetic characteristics

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between a species and a population.
(Species aur population mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Species duniya bhar mein aik qisam hai; population us ka aik jagah ka aik group hai.

book_ref.quote: A species refers to a "type" of organisms globally, while a population refers to a specific group in a specific location

rows: Duniya bhar mein jandaron ki aik "qisam".
Aik species ka aik khaas jagah par khaas group.
Members aapas mein fertile aulad paida kar sakte hain.
Aik hi species ke afraad, aik ilaqe mein, aik waqt par.
Misaal: poore Pakistan ke Markhor.
Misaal: Chitral Gol National Park ke Markhor.

blocks.prompt:
4 What is a community? Give the book's example.
(Community kya hai? Kitab ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Community aik ilaqe mein rehne aur aapas mein amal karne wali mukhtalif species (paude, janwar, fungi, bacteria) ki tamam populations hai. Misaal: Karachi ka mangrove forest jis mein mangrove darakht, mudskipper, kekray aur sahili parinde hain (parinde machhli khate hain).

book_ref.quote: They all share the same space and interact with one another

blocks.prompt:
5 Define ecosystem. Name its two components.
(Ecosystem ki tareef karein. Is ke do hisse batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ecosystem community aur us ka mahol hai. Is ke hisse:
1. Biotic (zinda) hisse.
2. Abiotic (ghair zinda) hisse jaise dhoop, mitti, paani aur hawa.

book_ref.quote: An ecosystem consists of the biotic (living) components and the abiotic (non-living) components

blocks.prompt:
6 Why is the Thar Desert called an ecosystem and not just a community?
(Thar Desert ko sirf community nahi balke ecosystem kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke is mein sirf community (saanp, blackbuck, jhaariyan) hi nahi balke abiotic factors (sakht garmi, sarakte ret ke teele, kam barish) bhi hain jo jandaron ke tarz-e-zindagi par asar dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: It not only contains the snakes, blackbucks, and shrubs (the community)

blocks.prompt:
7 Name three biomes of Pakistan with their locations.
(Pakistan ke teen biomes un ki jagah ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Coniferous Forest Biome: Murree aur Swat ke buland ilaqe.
2. Desert Biome: Thal aur Thar (kam barish).
3. Freshwater Biome: Indus River system.

book_ref.quote: Desert Biome is located in the Thal and Thar regions

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is the biosphere called the 'Global Ecosystem'?
(Biosphere ko 'Global Ecosystem' kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh tamam biomes ka aalmi majmua hai, zameen ke gird aik patla ghilaf jahan lithosphere (khushki), hydrosphere (paani) aur atmosphere (hawa) mil kar zindagi ko sahara dete hain.

book_ref.quote: It is a thin "envelope" around the Earth where the lithosphere (land), hydrosphere (water), and atmosphere (air) interact

blocks.prompt:
9 What is the range of the biosphere?
(Biosphere kahan se kahan tak phela hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein zameen ka har woh hissa hai jahan zindagi hai, Arabian Sea ki gehri khaiyon se Himalaya ki oonchi chotiyon tak, balke atmosphere mein kai kilometer oopar tak.

book_ref.quote: It refers to every part of the Earth where life exists

blocks.prompt:
10 What are biogeochemical cycles? Name four elements that move in them.
(Biogeochemical cycles kya hain? Chaar anasir ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Biogeochemical cycles kimiyai anasir ki ecosystem ke zinda aur ghair zinda hisson ke darmiyan chakkar dar harkat hain. Anasir: carbon, nitrogen, oxygen aur phosphorus.

book_ref.quote: Biogeochemcial cycles are the cyclic movements of chemical elements

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between gaseous and sedimentary cycles.
(Gaseous aur sedimentary cycles mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono biogeochemical cycles hain; in ka primary reservoir mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: On the basis of primary reservoir, the biogeochemical cycles are classified as

rows: Reservoir hawa ya samandar (evaporation ke zariye).
Reservoir zameen ki parat (crust).
Misaalein: nitrogen, oxygen, carbon, water cycles.
Misaalein: phosphorus, sulfur, calcium cycles.

blocks.prompt:
12 Define the water cycle. Why is it called a lifeline for Pakistan?
(Water cycle ki tareef karein. Ise Pakistan ki lifeline kyun kaha gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Water cycle (hydrological cycle) paani ki abiotic hisson (hawa, mitti, samandar) aur biotic hisson ke darmiyan musalsal harkat hai. Yeh lifeline hai kyun ke Pakistan ki zarat aur maeeshat poori tarah Indus River system par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: between abiotic components (air, soil, and sea) and biotic components

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the role of the sun in evaporation?
(Evaporation mein suraj ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Suraj poora water cycle chalata hai. Suraj ki shuaen samandar aur jheelon ka paani garam karti hain aur paani ke molecules ko bhaap banne ki energy deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Solar radiation heats the surface water in oceans and lakes

blocks.prompt:
14 How are clouds formed during condensation?
(Condensation mein badal kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oopar jati bhaap hararat khoti hai. Hawa kaafi thandi ho to bhaap qatron ya barf ke zarron mein badal jati hai jo gard ke zarron se chimat kar badal banate hain.

book_ref.quote: As water vapors rise into the atmosphere, they loses heat

blocks.prompt:
15 What is precipitation? Name its forms.
(Precipitation kya hai? Is ki shakalein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab badalon ke qatre bohat bhari ho jayen to gravity se girte hain; yeh precipitation hai. Darja hararat ke mutabiq paani barish, barf ya sleet (barf ya olon mili barish) ki shakal mein girta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the water droplets in clouds become too heavy, they fall due to gravity

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between infiltration and surface runoff.
(Infiltration aur surface runoff mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono zameen par girne ke baad paani ke raaste hain.

book_ref.quote: Water seeps into the soil (percolation)

rows: Paani mitti mein rista hai (percolation).
Zameen ki satah par paani ka khula behao.
Neeche water table tak jata hai.
Jab paani mitti mein mazeed jazb na ho sake.
Zair-e-zameen paani jama karta, aquifers bharta hai.
Nadi naalon, daryaon, samandar mein jata; Indus ko paani deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 How does water enter the biotic component of the water cycle?
(Paani water cycle ke biotic hisse mein kaise dakhil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Zameeni paude root hairs se mitti ka paani jazb karte aur photosynthesis aur sahare (turgor pressure) ke liye istemal karte hain.
2. Janwar meetha paani pee kar aur khurak kha kar paani lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Water enters biotic components primarily through two methods

blocks.prompt:
18 Write any four ways by which water leaves organisms and returns to the abiotic environment.
(Koi chaar tareeqe likhein jin se paani jandaron se nikal kar abiotic mahol mein jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Patton ke stomata se transpiration.
2. Respiration (metabolic water bhaap ban kar nikalta hai).
3. Excretion aur egestion (peshab aur fuzla).
4. Jild ke masamon se paseena; murda jismon ka decomposition bhi.

book_ref.quote: During perspiration (sweating), animals release water through skin pores

blocks.prompt:
19 Define the nitrogen cycle.
(Nitrogen cycle ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen cycle aik pecheeda amal hai jis se nitrogen ecosystem ke biotic aur abiotic hisson mein gardish karti hai. Is mein N₂ ko jandaron ke qabil-e-istemal compounds banana aur phir N₂ ki atmosphere mein wapsi shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves the transformation of atmospheric nitrogen (N₂) into compounds that can be used by living organisms

blocks.prompt:
20 Why can't plants use atmospheric nitrogen directly although air is 78% N₂?
(Hawa 78% N₂ hone ke bawajood paude ise seedha kyun istemal nahi kar sakte?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke N₂ ke atoms mazboot triple bond se jure hain jise paude nahi tor sakte. Pehle N₂ ko ammonia (NH₃) jaise compounds mein fix karna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: Plants cannot break these bonds

blocks.prompt:
21 Name the two kinds of nitrogen-fixing microorganisms with examples.
(Nitrogen fix karne wale microorganisms ki do qismen misaalon ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Azad (non-symbiotic): cyanobacteria (blue-green algae), Azotobacter, Clostridium.
2. Mutualistic (symbiotic): Rhizobium, Chana aur Moong jaisi legumes ki root nodules mein.

book_ref.quote: There are two kinds of nitrogen-fixing microorganisms

blocks.prompt:
22 What is atmospheric fixation of nitrogen?
(Nitrogen ki atmospheric fixation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barish aur toofan mein bijli bari energy de kar nitrogen ko oxygen se milati hai. N₂ pehle nitrogen oxides aur phir nitrates banti hai. Sirf 5-10% nitrogen is tarah fix hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, N₂ is converted int nitrogen oxides and then into nitrates

blocks.prompt:
23 What is industrial fixation of nitrogen?
(Nitrogen ki industrial fixation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Industrial fixation nitrogen wali khaad ki tayyari hai. Is mein atmospheric nitrogen aur hydrogen mila kar ammonia banai jati hai.

book_ref.quote: In this process, atmospheric nitrogen and hydrogen are combined to produce ammonia

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is nitrification needed for plants?
(Paudon ke liye nitrification kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia aksar zehreeli ya zyada miqdar mein paudon ke liye mushkil hoti hai. Nitrification ise (ammonia → nitrite → nitrate) nitrate banata hai jo paude aasani se jazb karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Ammonia is often toxic or difficult for plants to use in large amounts

blocks.prompt:
25 What is assimilation in the nitrogen cycle? How do animals obtain nitrogen?
(Nitrogen cycle mein assimilation kya hai? Janwar nitrogen kaise lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Assimilation woh amal hai jis mein paude aur microbes mitti se nitrates jazb kar ke proteins, DNA aur chlorophyll banate hain. Janwar paude aur doosre janwar kha kar nitrogen lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Animals assimilate nitrogen by consuming plants and other animals

blocks.prompt:
26 Why is denitrification necessary for the nitrogen cycle?
(Nitrogen cycle ke liye denitrification kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cycle ka tawazun qaim rakhne ke liye nitrogen ka aakhir hawa mein wapas jana zaroori hai. Paani bhari mitti mein denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas, Thiobacillus) nitrates ko N₂ bana kar hawa mein chhorte hain.

book_ref.quote: To keep the cycle balanced, nitrogen must eventually return to the air

blocks.prompt:
27 How does the flow of energy differ from the cycling of matter?
(Energy ka behao maadde ki cycling se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maadda (nutrients) zinda aur ghair zinda hisson mein baar baar cycle karta hai, jab ke energy ka behao aik taraf hai; woh wapas apne mamba ki taraf nahi jati.

book_ref.quote: Along with the matter, energy also flows between the physical environment and organisms

blocks.prompt:
28 Which organisms form trophic level 1 and what are they called?
(Trophic level 1 kaun se jandar banate hain aur unhein kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sabz paude, algae aur photosynthetic bacteria trophic level 1 banate hain. Yeh ecosystem ke primary producers hain.

book_ref.quote: These are the primary producers of an ecosystem

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between primary and secondary consumers.
(Primary aur secondary consumers mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono consumers hain; in ki khurak aur trophic level mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: Trophic level 3 consists of secondary consumers (carnivores)

rows: Herbivores (sabzi khor).
Carnivores (gosht khor) aur janwaron ke parasites.
Seedha producers khate hain.
Herbivores ko khate hain.
Trophic level 2.
Trophic level 3.
Misaalein: keeray, khargosh.
Misaalein: mendak, saanp.

blocks.prompt:
30 Why do decomposers and detritivores form a separate trophic level?
(Decomposers aur detritivores alag trophic level kyun banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh tamam trophic levels se khurak lete hain. Yeh detritus (murda gal-sar raha maadda) aur fuzla khate hain. Misaalein: kekray, girdh aur geedar.

book_ref.quote: Decomposers and detritivores (crabs, vultures, and jackals) make a separate trophic level

blocks.text: 25.3.2 The Loss of Energy between Trophic Levels

blocks.prompt:
31 What fraction of energy passes from one trophic level to the next? What happens to the rest?
(Aik trophic level se agle tak energy ka kitna hissa jata hai? Baqi ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf taqreeban 10% agle trophic level tak jata hai. Baqi har level par (hararat ban kar) zaya hota hai, is liye nizam mein bohat kam qabil-e-istemal energy bachti hai.

book_ref.quote: only about 10% is transferred to the next trophic level

blocks.prompt:
32 If producers fix 10,000 kcal, how much energy reaches primary, secondary and tertiary consumers?
(Agar producers 10,000 kcal fix karein to primary, secondary aur tertiary consumers ko kitni energy milti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Primary consumers: taqreeban 1,000 kcal.
Secondary consumers: taqreeban 100 kcal.
Tertiary consumers: 10,000 mein se taqreeban 10 kcal.

book_ref.quote: if producers fix 10,000 kcal energy by photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
33 Give reason: short food chains are more energy efficient than long food chains.
(Wajah batayein: chhoti food chains lambi chains se zyada energy efficient hain.)
blocks.explanation: Har trophic level par transfer ke dauran energy hararat ban kar zaya hoti hai. Chhoti chain mein kam levels (kam qadam) hain, is liye kam energy zaya hoti aur efficiency zyada hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, efficiency is higher when fewer steps are involved in the food chains

blocks.prompt:
34 Define demography. Which of its features is the most important?
(Demography ki tareef karein. Is ki sab se ahem khususiyat kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Demography populations ki khususiyaat ka shumariyati mutalia hai. Population size sab se ahem hai kyun ke yeh seedha population ke bachne ki salahiyat se juri hai.

book_ref.quote: because it is directly related to the ability of a given population to survive

blocks.prompt:
35 What is population survivorship? What do the axes of a survivorship graph show?
(Population survivorship kya hai? Survivorship graph ke axes kya dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Population survivorship kisi group ke un members ka feesad hai jo aik khaas umar par zinda hon. Graph mein Y-axis zinda bachne walon ki tadaad aur X-axis umar dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: In such graphs, the Y-axis shows the numbers of survivors, and the X-axis mentions age

blocks.prompt:
36 Describe the Type II (diagonal) survivorship curve with examples.
(Type II (diagonal) survivorship curve misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Type II mein afraad ki poori zindagi maut ka imkan barabar rehta hai. Mahol maut par ahem asar dalta hai aur bachon par boorhon se zyada sakht nahi. Misaalein: parinde, chhipkaliyan, rodents.

book_ref.quote: The environment has an important influence on death and is no harsher on the young than on the old

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between the exponential and logistic growth models.
(Exponential aur logistic growth models mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono growth models hain; aik ki koi had nahi, doosra carrying capacity tak pahunchta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Increase in the number of individuals within over a specific time period is called population growth

rows: Population bila had apni intihai raftaar se barhti hai.
Wasail ki kami se barhti population aakhir had tak pahunchti hai.
Har waqt ki ikai mein usi nisbat se barhti hai.
Aik khaas size, carrying capacity, par tham jati hai.
Har population yeh nahi dikhati.
Growth curve sigmoid (chapti S) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
38 Write two effects of high population density.
(Zyada population density ke do asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Carrying capacity ke qareeb wasail par sakht muqabla, paidaish kam aur maut ka khatra zyada.
2. Zyada density se aloodgi ki sharah barh sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: High population densities can also result in high rates of pollution

blocks.prompt:
39 What is random spacing? Give an example.
(Random spacing kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Random spacing mein afraad aapas mein zyada amal nahi karte. Yeh fitrat mein aam nahi. Misaal: hawa se bikharne wale beejon wale kuch paude jo jahan munasib jagah giren ug jate hain.

book_ref.quote: the individuals within populations do not interact strongly with one another

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between uniform and clumped spacing.
(Uniform aur clumped spacing mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono population mein afraad ke phelao ke andaaz hain.

book_ref.quote: some plant species inhibit the growth of nearby individuals, leading to a uniform distance between each plant

rows: Afraad barabar faasle par phele hote hain.
Afraad groups ya jhurmat mein jama hote hain.
Paude qareebi paudon ko rokte ya janwar ilaqa qaim rakhte hain.
Wasail ki na-barabar taqseem ki wajah se.
Misaal: ghonsla banate penguins.
Misaal: beej seedha zameen par girane wale paude; groups mein rehne wale janwar.

blocks.prompt:
41 Define carrying capacity. Name its limiting factors.
(Carrying capacity ki tareef karein. Is ke limiting factors batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Carrying capacity kisi species ke afraad ki woh zyada se zyada tadaad hai jise aik mahol lambe arse tak payedar taur par sahara de sake. Limiting factors: khurak, paani, panah, ghonslon ki jagah, aur shikari aur bimariyan.

book_ref.quote: The carrying capacity is the maximum number of individuals of a particular species

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is a population below its minimal viable size at high risk of extinction?
(Minimal viable size se kam population ko nasl khatam hone ka khatra kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Bohat chhoti population (maslan Pakistan ke chand Himalayan Brown Bears) mein inbreeding se genetic kamzoriyan aur bimariyon ke khilaf kam immunity.
2. Aik hi qudrati aafat jaise sailaab ya jangal ki aag ise mita sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: a single natural disaster (e.g., flood or forest fire) may wipe out a population

blocks.prompt:
43 What changes since the early 1700s allowed humans to expand the carrying capacity of their habitats?
(1700s ke shuru se kin tabdeeliyon ne insanon ko apne habitat ki carrying capacity barhane di?)
blocks.explanation: Technology ki tabdeeliyon se khurak par zyada qaboo, shikariyon se bachao ke behtar hathiyar aur bohat si bimariyon ka ilaj mila. Insan mausami be-yaqeeniyon ke aage kam kamzor ho gaye.

book_ref.quote: Starting in the early 1700s, changes in technology have given humans more control over their food supply

blocks.prompt:
44 How is the world's population divided between developed and developing countries?
(Duniya ki aabadi taraqqi yafta aur taraqqi pazeer mulkon mein kaise taqseem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 16% (1.28 arab) taraqqi yafta mulkon mein aur baqi 84% (6.72 arab) taraqqi pazeer mulkon mein rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: About 16% (1.28 billion) of the world's population lives in developed countries

blocks.prompt:
45 Compare resource use and CO₂ emission of the wealthiest and poorest 20% of the world's population.
(Duniya ke sab se ameer aur sab se ghareeb 20% ka wasail ka istemal aur CO₂ ikhraj muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ameer 20% ghareeb 20% se kahin zyada wasail istemal aur CO₂ kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The wealthiest 20% of the world’s population consumes 86% of the world’s resources

rows: Duniya ke 86% wasail istemal karte hain.
Sirf 1.3% wasail istemal karte hain.
Duniya ka 53% CO₂ ikhraj.
Sirf 3% CO₂ ikhraj.

blocks.prompt:
46 Define the greenhouse effect. Why is it necessary for life?
(Greenhouse effect ki tareef karein. Yeh zindagi ke liye kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Greenhouse effect woh qudrati amal hai jis mein atmosphere ki gases (GHGs) zameen ki satah se nikalne wali hararat ko qaid karti hain. Yeh dhoop andar aane deti hain magar hararat ko khala mein jane se rokti hain, is tarah zameen zindagi ke liye kaafi garam rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Greenhous effect is the natural process where gases present in Earth’s atmosphere trap the heat

blocks.prompt:
47 Which human activities have increased CO₂ concentration in the atmosphere?
(Kin insani sargarmiyon ne hawa mein CO₂ ki miqdar barhai hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh sargarmiyan jin mein fossil fuels istemal hote hain: mashinein chalana, gaariyan chalana, ghar garam karna aur bijli banana. Jangalaat ki katai se bhi CO₂ nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: The enhanced, unnatural warming of Earth’s atmosphere caused by excessive GHGs

blocks.prompt:
48 Name the sources of methane and nitrous oxide.
(Methane aur nitrous oxide ke zaraye batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Methane (CH₄): koyle aur gas ki paidawar, maweshi (gaaye mein enteric fermentation) aur zarai tareeqe.
Nitrous oxide (N₂O): zarai aur sanati sargarmiyan aur fossil fuels ka jalna.

book_ref.quote: It is emitted during agricultural and industrial activities, and during combustion of fossil fuels

blocks.prompt:
49 Define global warming. What is its primary cause?
(Global warming ki tareef karein. Is ki bunyadi wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Global warming insani sargarmiyon ki wajah se zameen ke ausat darja hararat mein taweel muddati izafa hai. Is ki bunyadi wajah zyada GHGs ke ikhraj se tez hua greenhouse effect hai.

book_ref.quote: It refers to the long-term increase in the Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities

blocks.prompt:
50 Write any four effects of heatwaves caused by global warming.
(Global warming se heatwaves ke koi chaar asraat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. 50°C se upar jism darja hararat qaboo nahi kar sakta, jaanleva heatstroke.
2. Maweshi heat stress ka shikar.
3. Chhoti garam sardiyon mein keeray aur machhar zyada der zinda rehte hain.
4. Garmi khushk saali barhati aur garam khushk mausam jangal ki aag ka khatra barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Global warming has turned cities like Jacobabad and Sibi into some of the hottest places on Earth

blocks.prompt:
51 How does a warmer atmosphere lead to floods? Write two long-term damages of floods.
(Garam atmosphere sailaab ka sabab kaise banta hai? Sailaab ke do taweel muddati nuqsanat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Garam atmosphere zyada nami rakhta hai, jis se be-qaida shadeed barish aur 'turbo-charged' monsoon aur sailaab aate hain. Taweel muddati nuqsan: mitti ka kataao aur nutrients ki kami, aur paani ke zakhair ki aloodgi.

book_ref.quote: A warmer atmosphere holds more moisture, leading to erratic and intense rainfall

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between a GLOF and a cloudburst.
(GLOF aur cloudburst mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono garmi se jure achanak paani ki aafaten hain.

book_ref.quote: A cloudburst is a sudden and extremely heavy rainfall in a short period over a small area

rows: Glacial jheel se paani ka achanak ikhraj.
Achanak aur intihai shadeed barish.
Jheel ka qudrati band (maslan barf) tootne se.
Kam waqt mein chhote ilaqe par.
Paani 100 km se zyada door tak ja kar neeche ke ilaqe mutasir karta hai.
Chhota ilaqa mutasir hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
53 How does global warming cause food insecurity?
(Global warming food insecurity ka sabab kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Gandum aur chawal ke phool aane ke waqt zyada garmi daane ki paidawar kafi kam kar deti hai.
2. Shadeed garmi mitti ki nami urati aur zarkhez zameen ko sehra bana deti hai (desertification).

book_ref.quote: High temperatures during the flowering stage of Wheat and Rice can significantly reduce grain yield

blocks.prompt:
